IncludesDialogVideoInfo.xml.new_block:
<variable name="InfoDialogTMDbBingieHelperNextUpContent">
        <!-- Was plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper's own info=trakt_upnext,
             which needs Trakt scrobbling to know anything: XStream Player
             never scrobbles there, so it always fell back to Season 1
             Episode 1 no matter how much had actually been watched. Now
             asks XStream Player directly, which has its own real watch
             history and returns an actual resume/next-episode target when
             one exists, falling back to the same Season 1 Episode 1
             default otherwise so this is never worse than before. -->
        <value condition="String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow) + String.IsEmpty(ListItem.DBID) + Skin.HasSetting(videoinfo_button_play_next_tmdb) + String.IsEqual(ListItem.Path,plugin://plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper/) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.UniqueID(tmdb)) + System.HasAddon(plugin.video.xstream-player)">plugin://plugin.video.xstream-player/?mode=xtream_next_up&showname=$ESCINFO[ListItem.Title]&year=$ESCINFO[ListItem.Year]&profile_num=1</value>
        <value condition="String.IsEqual(ListItem.DBType,tvshow) + String.IsEmpty(ListItem.DBID) + Skin.HasSetting(videoinfo_button_play_next_tmdb) + String.IsEqual(ListItem.Path,plugin://plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper/) + !String.IsEmpty(ListItem.UniqueID(tmdb))">plugin://plugin.video.tmdb.bingie.helper/?info=trakt_upnext&tmdb_id=$INFO[ListItem.UniqueID(tmdb)]&tmdb_type=tv&cacheonly=true</value>
    </variable>
